title: Deterministic Rasterization for Visual Snapshots
description: Trace how OS font hinting and async web fonts cause false diffs, and how containerization stabilizes pixels.

steps.label: 1. Host-OS Divergence (macOS vs Linux)
steps.description: macOS CoreText and Linux FreeType rasterize anti-aliased glyph edges differently, causing false diffs.
steps.codeHighlight: // macOS Retina DPR=2 vs Linux CI DPR=1 produces 3.2% pixel diff

steps.label: 2. Pin Container & Await Fonts
steps.description: Run in pinned Linux Docker Chromium, emulate reducedMotion, and await document.fonts.ready.
steps.codeHighlight: await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' }); await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);

steps.label: 3. Capture Deterministic PNG
steps.description: Skia produces identical software-rasterized pixel buffers with 0.0% diff across CI workers.
